generation_full: The IRS has a new rule that allows taxpayers to claim dependents on their tax return to get a larger refund. The rule was announced on March 15, 2019, and it is effective for tax years beginning after December 31, 2018. The rule allows taxpayers to claim dependents on their tax return to get a larger refund by filing a Form 8832, Claiming Dependents on Your Tax Return, with the IRS. The form requires taxpayers to provide information about their dependents, including their ages, names, and addresses. The IRS will then review the information and determine whether to accept the claim. If the IRS accepts the claim, the taxpayer will receive a larger refund than if they had not claimed dependents on their tax return.
